newsitem.title: USA: Energy Conversion sees Q2 loss less than Q1 loss.
newsitem.headline: Energy Conversion sees Q2 loss less than Q1 loss.

text.p: Energy Conversion Devices Inc said Thursday it expects to report a loss for its second fiscal quarter, but it will be "significantly" less than the loss reported for its first quarter.

"ECD also said that while results for the second quarter ended December 31, 1996 will indicate continued growth in product sales and revenues from business agreements, it anticipates a loss for the second quarter which will be significantly less than the loss incurred in the first quarter," the company said in a statement.
ECD reported a loss of $0.36 a share in its first quarter, versus a profit of $0.04 a share for the first quarter the previous year.
ECD develops technology for alternative energy sources.
